_meta.capture_method: Direct fetch() via javascript_tool — read_network_requests does not expose request/response bodies.
_meta.note: Each Save call replaces the entire wp_option with only the fields in payload (no merge). To preserve negative baseline, the final canonical B-negative was re-run AFTER the filter-validation sub-cases so the persisted state matches negative.

B_negative.description: Flip toggles back, alt selects, empty repeaters, reset category commission to defaults

B_admin_percentage_150_fixed.description: Send admin_percentage=150 with commission_type=fixed; expected clamp via validate_fixed_price_values
B_admin_percentage_150_fixed.verdict: Clamped: filter `validate_fixed_price_values` replaced 150 with `dokan_get_option('admin_percentage', 'dokan_selling', '0')`. Since the previously-stored admin_percentage was empty string (set by B-negative), the clamp value falls back to the EMPTY STRING, not to '0' as the default suggests — because dokan_get_option only returns the third-arg default when the key is unset, not when it is set to empty string.

B_admin_percentage_neg10_flat.description: Send admin_percentage=-10 with commission_type=flat; expected clamp
B_admin_percentage_neg10_flat.verdict: Clamped: same fallback to previously-saved (empty) admin_percentage.

B_commission_type_empty.description: Send commission_type='' (empty); expected `set_commission_type_if_not_set` filter to default to 'fixed' on read
B_commission_type_empty.verdict: Filter fires: response shows commission_type=fixed even though payload was empty. (Filter runs in the post-save `dokan_get_settings_values` chain inside save_settings_value's response builder.) See round-trip confirmation in dokan_selling_reload.json.

B_new_seller_enable_selling_legacy_on.verdict: Stored verbatim as 'on'. Mapper in save_settings_value is NOT applied on save; only get_settings_value() maps 'on'→'automatically' / 'off'→'manually' via AdminSettings::get_new_seller_enable_selling_status. The save-response builder reuses the dokan_get_settings_values filter chain but the legacy mapper is gated by `! in_array($status, $settings, true)` (line 136), which is brittle (in_array against an associative array of arrays). See round-trip confirmation in reload.
